title: The Best Mac and Cheese Hack Ever!
description: A quick and easy mac and cheese recipe made in a 9x13 baking sheet with Velveeta, Monterey Jack, and Pepper Jack cheeses, topped with a buttery garlic breadcrumb mixture.

ingredients.item: Four cups of heavy whipping cream
One and a half cups of water

steps: Put the Velveeta cheese right in a 9x13 baking sheet.
Place the macaroni noodles around the Velveeta.
Pour the heavy whipping cream over the noodles and cheese.
Add the shredded Monterey Jack cheese.
Bake at 375 Fahrenheit for approximately 30 minutes.
While baking, spice up the breadcrumbs: mix with a few tablespoons of butter, garlic powder, pepper, salt, parsley flake, and grated Parmesan.
After 30 minutes, stir all of the ingredients together until the noodles are soft and the cheese is well combined.
Add the prepared breadcrumb mixture on top.
Broil for approximately five to eight minutes, or until the breadcrumbs are nicely browned.
notes:
The author mentions this is a hack and that they would be making it more often if it's good. The final result was described as 'Best mac and cheese ever I had'.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1D6bx8Nejh/

not_healthy: 32 oz Velveeta and four cups of heavy cream make it extremely high in saturated fat.
Processed cheese and several other cheeses make it very high in sodium.
Two pounds of white macaroni is mostly refined carbs.
